method: Three entry-level seeded trials per map/build, including single-column formation; 180s regular maps or 600s bosses, capped at map goal; full HP, empty combat buffs, staged gear, at most 30 or 60 points, no crafted stats, legacy upgrades or developer items.
limitations: Three deterministic seeds per build/map, not a guarantee against every random outcome.
Appropriate staged equipment, full starting health, empty combat buffs, fixed minimum entry level, and no crafted rolls.
Builds spend at most 30 or 60 points; no legacy upgrades, developer gear, or rare weapon drops.
